'''Laurie Hymes''' is an American voice actress for the English-language [[dub]] of {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Hymes was born on March 5, 1982, in San Diego, California. As an adult, she became a voice actress in 2013 and immediately started out working for the English-dubbed versions of a number of foreign series. In 2014, she began working for {{aniseries|PTS}} during {{aniseries|XY}} and eventually landed two of her best-known roles: [[Team Flare]] scientist [[Mable]], who appeared in ''Pokémon the Series: XY''; and {{an|Lillie}}, a main character in {{aniseries|SM}}. Hymes currently resides in New York City, New York, with her husband, [[Ryan Nicolls]], who has also voiced characters in [[Pokémon]].
